description: A draggable, keyboard-accessible control for selecting one value (or a range) along a track.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the child element in place of the default `<span>` via the
{@link Slot } pattern, merging `Slider.Root`'s `dir`, `data-*` hooks and
ref onto it; the shared controller listens on it for presses.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The value array on first render — one number per
{@link SliderThumb `Slider.Thumb`}, in order (`[value]` for a single
thumb, `[low, high]` for a range). After mount the component owns the
value. Defaults to `[min]` when omitted.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction of a horizontal slider; see {@link SliderDirection}.
Affects which end is the minimum, the arrow-key direction, pointer
mapping, and the inline positioning styles. When omitted, it is inherited
from the nearest {@link DirectionProvider }, falling back to `"ltr"` when
there is no provider; an explicit prop always wins.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disable all interaction. Every part receives `data-disabled=""`, thumbs
leave the tab order and gain `aria-disabled="true"`, and both keyboard and
pointer handlers become no-ops.

props.name: inverted
props.description:
Reverse the direction the value increases along the axis. Combines with
{@link SliderRootSharedProps.orientation`orientation`} and
{@link SliderRootSharedProps.dir`dir`} to flip the pointer mapping,
arrow keys, and the edge the thumb/range offset is anchored to.

props.name: max
min
minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description:
Minimum gap, expressed **in steps**, enforced between adjacent thumbs on a
multi-thumb slider. The gap in value units is `minStepsBetweenThumbs *
step`. A thumb is clamped so it can never come closer than this to its
neighbours (and can never cross them). Has no effect on a single-thumb
slider.

props.name: name
props.description:
When set, `Slider.Root` renders one hidden `<input>` per thumb carrying
that thumb's value so the slider posts with a surrounding `<form>`. A
multi-thumb slider suffixes the name with `[]` (e.g. `name="range"` →
`range[]`); a single-thumb slider uses the bare name. When omitted, no
hidden inputs are rendered.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the full next value array on every change (each arrow-key
press and every pointer increment during a drag). Optional in
uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description:
Called **once** with the settled value array when an interaction ends — a
pointer release, or a completed keyboard press. Use it to persist only the
final value rather than every intermediate step.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout axis of the track; see {@link SliderOrientation}. Sets
`data-orientation` and each thumb's `aria-orientation`, and selects which
pointer axis and arrow keys drive the value.

props.name: step
props.description:
Granularity of the value: every thumb value snaps to a multiple of `step`
anchored at `min`, and each arrow-key press moves by one `step` (Page
Up/Down move by ten). Fractional steps (e.g. `0.1`) are snapped to the
step's decimal precision. Must be greater than `0`; `Slider.Root` throws
during render otherwise.

props.name: value
props.description:

The current value array — one number per
{@link SliderThumb `Slider.Thumb`}, in order (`[value]` for a single
thumb, `[low, high]` for a range). Must be kept in sync by the parent via
`onValueChange`.

api.description:
`<primitiv-slider>` — the state owner of a slider: one or more thumbs along a track, each picking a value between `min` and `max` in `step`s.

Each `<primitiv-slider-thumb>` is itself the `role="slider"`: give it an `aria-label` (or `aria-labelledby`). Every thumb is in the Tab order. The arrows step by one `step`, Page Up / Page Down by ten, Home / End jump to the ends; a press on the slider jumps the nearest thumb there and drags it until release. A thumb never passes its neighbours.

**Positions are written inline**, as React's Slider does: each thumb and the range get `position: absolute` and their inset along the track as a percentage — the one style the elements write, since it is the value itself (RFC 0033 D25). Style everything else from the attributes.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Each thumb's value, separated by spaces, in thumb order. Reflected: it changes as the user moves a thumb, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live values. Defaults to `min`.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The interval values snap to. Defaults to `1`. Read at each interaction.

attributes.name: min-steps-between-thumbs
attributes.description: How many steps apart neighbouring thumbs must stay. Defaults to `0`. Read at each interaction.

attributes.name: inverted
attributes.description: Run from the opposite end: `max` at the start edge.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Ignore keys and presses, and take the thumbs out of the Tab order.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Submit the values with a form: the slider keeps one hidden `<input>` per value inside itself, named `name` (or `name[]` for several thumbs).

events.name: primitiv-slider-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before each user-driven change is applied, with every thumb's value afterwards — on every step of a drag. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-slider-commit
events.description: Bubbles, fired once an interaction ends — a key press, or the release of a drag — with the values the slider then holds.

api.description: `<primitiv-slider-track>` — a structural part: the bar the range fills.
`<primitiv-slider-range>` — a structural part: the filled stretch of the track, from its start edge to a single thumb or between the outermost of several. Positioned inline from the values.

`<primitiv-slider-thumb>` — a handle, and itself the `role="slider"`: it gets `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-orientation`, the Tab stop and its inline position. Its value is the root's value at the thumb's position in document order. Name each with `aria-label`.
